Repair this rejected 8-beat ARC. Return ONLY one JSON object with an events array of exactly 8 complete events. Preserve source order and all persistent facts. The validator issue is that the explicit majority sequence is represented in only 3/8 beats; at least 5/8 beats must materially belong to it and it must begin no later than Beat 4.

SOURCE STORY:
Amy cooks breakfast for Will and Amber wearing a black tank top and denim jeans. A zombie breaks the kitchen door window. Amy rushes Will and Amber into the basement and locks the door. She retrieves a pistol and katana. The majority of the film is Amy killing, dismembering, and decapitating zombies as they attack her. Amy kills the last zombie, leaving the house soaked in blood, then lets Will and Amber out of the basement.

MAJORITY REPAIR RULES:
- The plural/repeated zombie-killing process authorizes as many ordinary zombie instances as the numeric majority requires. The three zombie entities already named in the rejected ARC are NOT a source-level cap.
- Create distinct additional ordinary zombie instances as needed; do not split or kill the same zombie twice just to fill beats.
- A beat counts only when Amy materially performs the emphasized process itself. Danger, approach, preparation, weapon retrieval, and prerequisites do NOT count by themselves.
- Because Beats 1-3 consume the outside-sequence budget, Beats 4-8 must each materially contain Amy killing/fighting a zombie.
- Bundle remaining adjacent setup into the START of Beat 4's counted combat job.
- Preserve the explicit last/final zombie as the terminal combat instance in Beat 8, and bundle the immediate child-release resolution into the END of Beat 8.
